purpose: Reported observations for assay-matched calibration or model checking; no transferable mhctools rate defaults

studies.formulation: nucleoside-modified reporter mRNA in study-specific LNP

rna_assay.assay: branched-DNA hybridization for reporter RNA in sampled tissue or plasma
rna_assay.source_locator: Results, Figure 3A-B and Methods, NHP studies
rna_assay.interpretation: Pooled concentration summaries; first collections may miss peaks. Hybridization signal does not count active cytosolic transcripts or encoded pMHC. Tissue mass and plasma volume are different denominators.

protein_assay.construct: EGFP reporter, measured in a separate macaque experiment
protein_assay.assay: flow cytometry, EGFP-positive fraction of each node cell subset
protein_assay.source_locator: Results, Figure 6B and Methods, separate NHP cell study
protein_assay.interpretation: Reporter-positive cell prevalence is neither injected-dose recovery nor core-specific surface pMHC.

studies.assays: short-amplicon plasma ddPCR for total vaccine RNA; two-amplicon linkage for relative integrity; plasma lipid mass spectrometry
studies.source_locator: Results, Figures 1-3 and Methods, RNA and lipid decay fits
studies.interpretation: Blood observables after a booster; two-amplicon linkage does not prove full-length translation-competent RNA. Post-peak circulating signal includes previous input and is not intracellular RNA loss, antigen clearance or core half-life.

studies.formulation: study-specific BNT162b2-type LNP containing OVA or GFP reporter mRNA
studies.assay: 25D1.16 SIINFEKL/H-2Kb flow-cytometry MFI divided by total H-2Kb MFI on GFP-positive draining-node cDC2
studies.interpretation: Categorical time points transcribed from the authors' comparison, not digitized MFI values. No absolute pMHC copy count, source shutoff, or intrinsic complex lifetime is identified.
